blocks.text: Volumetric analysis mein solutions ki concentration (fi hajm miqdar) titration naam ke tareeqe se maloom ki jati hai. Is mein anjaan concentration wala solution, standard solution (jis ki concentration maloom ho) ke maloom volume ke saath aahista aahista milaya jata hai, jab tak rang ki tabdeeli yeh na bata de ke reaction mukammal ho gaya.

blocks.title: Indicator
blocks.text: Woh madda jo apna rang badal kar batata hai ke reaction mukammal ho gaya, indicator kehlata hai.

blocks.title: End point
blocks.text: Jis lamhe indicator apna rang badalta hai, use end point kehte hain.
Dono mein se koi bhi solution burette mein liya ja sakta hai aur doosra conical flask (titration flask) mein.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Phenolphthalein solution banane ke liye 1 gram indicator ko 500 cm³ 50% ethanol mein dalte hain. Titrate hone wale 10 cm³ solution mein sirf ek ya do qatre dalein. pH kam hone par is ka rang gulabi se be-rang hota hai. End point wala halka gulabi rang hawa ki carbon dioxide ke dheere dheere solution mein ghulne ki wajah se aahista aahista phika par jata hai.
Zaroori saman (Materials Required)
Burette, pipette, funnel, conical flask, HCl solution, NaOH solution, phenolphthalein.
Titration ka tareeqa (Procedure)

items: Pipette ko pehle distilled water se, phir diye gaye NaOH solution se dhoyein (rinse karein).
Conical flask ko sirf distilled water se dhoyein.
Pipette se 10 cm³ NaOH solution conical flask mein dalein.
Is mein phenolphthalein indicator ke ek ya do qatre dalein. Solution gulabi (pink) ho jata hai.
Burette ko pehle distilled water se, phir diye gaye HCl solution se dhoyein.
Burette ko clamp stand par bilkul seedha (upright) lagayein.
Funnel ki madad se burette mein HCl solution bharein, phir funnel nikal dein.
Burette ke neeche wali tap khol kar thora acid beaker mein girayein taake nozzle mein phansa hawa ka bulbula nikal jaye.
Anti-parallax card ya safed kaghaz ki madad se burette ki reading parhein; yeh initial (ibtidai) reading hai.
Titration ke dauran conical flask ko burette ke neeche safed kaghaz par rakhein taake indicator ka rang badalna saaf nazar aaye. Dekh lein ke burette se leak na ho.
Burette se hydrochloric acid qatra qatra flask mein dal kar ek rough (andaze wali) titration karein.
Acid dalte waqt flask ko ghumate (swirl karte) rahein taake sab achhi tarah mil jaye.
Acid tab tak dalte rahein jab tak gulabi rang bilkul ghayab ho kar solution be-rang (colourless) na ho jaye. Yahi reaction ka end point hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke step xiii mein likha hai ke acid tab tak dalein jab tak rang 'light pink persistently' ho jaye. Yahan NaOH flask mein hai aur phenolphthalein ki wajah se shuru se gulabi hai; acid dalne se end point par gulabi rang ghayab ho kar solution be-rang (colourless) ho jata hai. Is liye sahi: acid tab tak dalein jab tak gulabi rang bilkul ghayab na ho jaye aur solution be-rang rahe. Kitab ka 'Did you know' bhi kehta hai ke pH girne par rang gulabi se be-rang hota hai.
Ab dobara burette ki reading parhein; yeh final (aakhri) reading hai. Final aur initial reading ka farq istemal hue acid ka volume hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch marahil: pipette se NaOH solution conical flask mein; dropper se indicator dalne par solution gulabi (pink); burette mein acid, initial reading aur tap band (Hold); tap khol kar (Release) acid ke qatre gulabi solution mein; final reading, tap band, aur flask ka solution be-rang.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.6: Titration ka tareeqa (kitab ki Figure 16.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein pipette par 'Acid solution' likha hai aur aakhir mein flask gulabi ho jata hai, yani acid flask mein aur base burette mein. Magar kitab ka apna tareeqa NaOH ko pipette se flask mein aur HCl ko burette mein rakhta hai. Is surat mein phenolphthalein dalte hi NaOH gulabi ho jata hai aur end point par gulabi rang ghayab ho jata hai (gulabi se be-rang, jaisa kitab ka 'Did you know' kehta hai). Hum ne tareeqe ke mutabiq sahih tasveer banayi hai: pipette mein NaOH, flask gulabi, aur aakhri flask be-rang.
Sahi aur concordant (aapas mein milti hui) readings ke liye titration dohrayein. Kam az kam teen concordant readings lein jo aapas mein 0.1 cm³ ke andar hon.
Istemal hue HCl solution ka volume = ________ cm³
Chemical equation

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: NaOH (base) aur HCl (acid) 1 : 1 mein react kar ke namak (NaCl) aur pani banate hain. Is liye molarity equation mein n₁ = 1 aur n₂ = 1 hain.
Hisab (Calculation)
NaOH solution ki molarity is molarity equation se nikalein:

items: M₁ = acid solution ki molarity
V₁ = istemal hue acid ka volume
n₁ = balanced chemical equation mein acid ke moles
M₂ = base solution ki molarity
V₂ = istemal hue base solution ka volume
n₂ = balanced chemical equation mein base ke moles

blocks.text: Diye gaye base solution ki molarity ____ M hai.

blocks.text: Quick Check 16.2

blocks.prompt: a) Titration mein indicator aur end point ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation: Indicator woh madda hai jo rang badal kar batata hai ke reaction mukammal ho gaya (jaise phenolphthalein). End point woh lamha hai jab indicator rang badalta hai; is titration mein gulabi rang ghayab hota hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Concordant reading se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Dohrai gayi titrations ki woh readings jo aapas mein 0.1 cm³ ke andar milti hon. Kam az kam teen concordant readings li jati hain taake nateeja sahi ho.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Titration: anjaan solution ko standard solution se end point tak milaya jata hai; indicator rang badal kar end point batata hai.
Phenolphthalein: pH kam hone par gulabi se be-rang; is titration mein end point par gulabi rang ghayab hota hai.
NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O; M₁V₁/n₁ = M₂V₂/n₂ se base ki molarity M₂ nikalti hai.
